newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DKLS Industries suspended for news.
newsitem.headline: DKLS Industries suspended for news.

text.p: Malaysian construction and quarry operations company DKLS Industries Bhd asked for a suspension in its stock price pending a company announcement, a statement from the company said.
In a statement released late on Wednesday, DKLS said the news is concerning "business proposals," but did not provide details. Company officials were not immediately available to elaborate.
Shares of DKLS last traded at 13 ringgit on Wednesday. The company listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on October 18.
